mike-infra: Hey @vendor-supply-co — we received 6 DOA A100s from the 48-unit shipment. Can you confirm whether you can do a consolidated RMA with partial air replacement?
jin-supply: Sorry to hear that. Which serials are DOA? We need serials + photos to open RMA case with the depot.
olivia-ops: We spotted node tears on 3 racks during the health-checks. Cluster impact low but want replacements staged before Wed midnight maintenance window.
mike-infra: Serial list pasted below and attached logs. Prefer 12 units by air (to cover critical clusters) and rest by ground. Also need insurance on air shipments. Any uplift on cost?
vendor-supply-co: Thanks — we can do 12 by air, rest ground. We need S/Ns to validate warranty; insurance is additional at 0.5% declared value unless waived. If you accept DAP we can cover customs clearance but not duties.
vendor-supply-co: Here's what we'd need now:
```
DOA S/Ns: RDX-A100-0012, RDX-A100-0056, RDX-A100-0099, RDX-A100-0210, RDX-A100-0333, RDX-A100-0450
Preferred split: 12 air / 36 ground
Declared value (per unit): $12,500
Insurance rate (air): 0.5% => ~$62.50/unit
Expedite air uplift: +18% on unit freight
```
dana-ops: For customs: if we route via FRA there's a higher chance of hold. Recommend NL cross-dock or direct to our DE depot (we have clearance there).
jin-supply: Can vendor list Redwood as consignee for DAP? If not, we need proforma invoices for our AP to create a credit hold.
vendor-supply-co: We can list Redwood as consignee under DAP. We will send AWBs once manifest is confirmed. We can also split invoices: one invoice per shipment batch (air vs ground).
finance-amy: Please itemize the air uplift and insurance separately. We'll approve vendor credit for DOA returns once RMA case is closed and unit tags verified.
rma-bot: rma:case:45871 created by jin-supply — status: awaiting vendor confirmation. Attach photos and S/Ns to accelerate depot acceptance.
olivia-ops: To reduce downtime, can vendor pre-stage replacement config images at DE depot? We want hot-swap with minimal re-imaging.
vendor-supply-co: We can stage images but need SSH key provisioning from you. Also confirm if exchanges are allowed (send replacement units, vendor retrieves faulty) vs depot-repair.
mike-infra: Exchange preferred. Vendor retrieves faulty chassis from depot. Does retrieval incur pickup fee?
vendor-supply-co: Dependent on depot — ground retrieval included; air retrieval has pickup fee (~€150/pickup) unless we bundle into AWB return.
jin-supply: We'll absorb pickup fee for air if vendor can waive customs broker fee. Also propose vendor cover insurance for DOA returns in first 30 days.
vendor-supply-co: We can waive broker fee for this batch as a one-off if Redwood confirms 48-unit reorder within 60 days. Insurance on returns: cannot cover DOA returns (vendor risk) but will offer credit once depot verifies failure.
mike-infra: Ok — Redwood agrees to reorder 48 units in 60 days pending spare budget confirmation. Please send AWBs and manifest by EOD so ops can schedule maintenance.
vendor-supply-co: Understood. I will push AWBs for the 12-air replacements by 16:30 CET and full manifest by EOD.
mike-infra: thanks :airplane: :heavy_check_mark:
olivia-ops: tagging ops schedule: please reserve Fri 22:00-02:00 UTC for node swaps.
finance-amy: noted — awaiting line items. mike-infra please cc AP when vendor invoices.
jin-supply: Uploaded photos and rack logs to rma:case:45871. rma-bot: please update when AWBs are posted.
rma-bot: rma:case:45871 update — vendor AWBs pending.
vendor-supply-co: AWB (air batch): EW123456789NL -> ETA 2026-03-24 10:30 CET. Insurance paid, manifest attached.
vendor-supply-co: ground manifest to follow. Thanks all.
mike-infra: received AWB — forwarding to ops. Let's close once replacements are received and faulty units collected.
